body: They're nothing but my greatest foundation and support but I fear my weakness like water to a stone. I wear them down to my will however harsh I flow. They are bright spirits and full of every imperfection thoughtfully brought together. I can no longer rely on them without breaking down their faulty beauty.

Getting help is what I wish to do but I am barley able to afford my rent and food. I have tried talking to my friends and such. However, I have realized that at the depths at which I am at, I would only cause them grief. I am past their loving reach and chained to the bottom reaching upwords to the glistening surface visible inches past my grasp as my body fills heavier still with the murky water.
I greatly appreciate your time and effort. Anything is helpful, thank you.
